dialogue.content: 今晩は。本日も宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for coming to our session today.

dialogue.content: はい。少しお待ち下さいね
dialogue.English: Yes. Just a moment, please.

dialogue.content: 承知しました。
dialogue.English: Understood.

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm ready.

dialogue.content: それでは、始めさせて頂きます。宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Alright then, let's begin. Thank you for being here.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今晩は。相談員です。本日は相談に来ていただきありがとうございます。始めに年齢と性別を教えて頂けますか。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in today. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 40歳　女性です
dialogue.English: I'm a 40-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。本日はどのような、ご相談でしょうか。
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: はい。私は今、近くのスーパーで働いているんですが、辞めるかどうかで、凄く悩んでいます
dialogue.English: Yes. I'm currently working at a nearby supermarket, and I'm really struggling with whether or not I should quit.

dialogue.content: それは、とてもお辛いですね。
dialogue.English: That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 辞めるかどうか悩んでおられるのは、どのようなご事情かお教えいただけますか。
dialogue.English: Could you tell me more about what is making you consider quitting?

dialogue.content: はい。私には5才の娘がいて、今保育園に預けて仕事をしているんですが、先日熱を出して迎えにきて欲しいと言われたんですが、仕事を抜けれなくて、義母に迎えに行ってもらったら、主人に仕事を辞めろと言われたんです
dialogue.English: Yes. I have a five-year-old daughter, and I work while she's at daycare. The other day, she came down with a fever and they asked me to pick her up, but I couldn't get away from work. I had my mother-in-law go get her, and then my husband told me to quit my job.

dialogue.content: それは、とてもお困りでしたね。
dialogue.English: That must have been very troubling for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 仕事と育児や家事を両立させていくのは、本当に大変ですよね。
dialogue.English: Balancing work with childcare and housework is really challenging, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい。大変ですけど、私が仕事をしたいと言ったので…
dialogue.English: Yes. It's difficult, but I was the one who said I wanted to work…

dialogue.content: それで、仕事を辞めろなんて言われたら、嫌になると思います。
dialogue.English: And then to be told to quit your job on top of that... I can imagine that would be very upsetting.

dialogue.content: 相談者さんが仕事をしたいとおしゃった理由をお教えいただけますか。
dialogue.English: Could you tell me why you wanted to work?

dialogue.content: ずっと働いてきて、やりがいもあるし、ずっと家にいたら、凄くイライラすると思って
dialogue.English: I've always worked, and I find it rewarding. I also think I would get very irritable if I stayed at home all the time.

dialogue.content: お仕事好きなんですね。素晴らしいことだと思います。
dialogue.English: You really enjoy your work, don't you? I think that's wonderful.

dialogue.content: 家庭に迷惑をかけないからと言う主人との約束だから、辞めろと言われても仕方ないんですけど
dialogue.English: But I promised my husband that it wouldn't be an inconvenience to the family, so I feel like I can't really argue with him telling me to quit.

dialogue.content: 辞めたく無いなぁとも思いますし
dialogue.English: But at the same time, I don't want to quit.

dialogue.content: 悩みます
dialogue.English: I'm so conflicted.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。そうなりますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It's understandable that you feel that way.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お子さんが突然、保育園で熱をだすことは、一般的にも良くあることだと思います。ご主人は、相談者さんが迎えに行けなかったことがそんなに、腹立たしいと思っていらっしゃる。
dialogue.English: It's quite common for children to suddenly get a fever at daycare. Your husband seems to be very upset that you weren't able to go pick her up.

dialogue.content: 相談者さんにはお家にいて欲しい理由がおありなのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Do you think he has a particular reason for wanting you to stay home?

dialogue.content: 義母に迷惑をかけたし、たまたま今回は義母が迎えにいけたけれど、いつも行ける訳じゃないし
dialogue.English: It inconvenienced my mother-in-law, and while she happened to be available to pick her up this time, that won't always be the case.

dialogue.content: それに、実は、主人の連れ子なんです
dialogue.English: Also, the truth is, she's my husband's child from a previous marriage.

dialogue.content: 再婚だから
dialogue.English: It's a second marriage.

dialogue.content: そうでいらっしゃいましたか。
dialogue.English: Oh, I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お子さんとの関係は良好ですか。
dialogue.English: Is your relationship with your daughter a good one?

dialogue.content: はい。私はなかなか子どもが出来なくて可愛いんですけど、ずっとその子の為に家にいるのも何だかもやもやするんです
dialogue.English: Yes. I haven't been able to have children of my own, so she's very dear to me, but I have mixed feelings about staying home all the time just for her sake.

dialogue.content: そうですね。実の子でもずーっと一緒にいるとそうなることがあると思います。
dialogue.English: I understand. I think that can happen sometimes even with one's own biological child if you're with them constantly.

dialogue.content: 仕事が好きですし、確かにこれから先も熱を出したりするじゃないですか…どうしようかと
dialogue.English: I enjoy my work, and it's true that she'll probably get fevers again in the future… I'm just not sure what to do.

dialogue.content: そうですね。そうれは、十分にありうるお話ですね。どうしたらいいか、一緒に考えてみましょう。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's certainly possible. Let's think together about what we can do.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 今の職場で働かれてどれくらいになりますか。
dialogue.English: How long have you been working at your current job?

dialogue.content: 今の職場は結婚してからなので、3年位です
dialogue.English: I've been at this job since I got married, so it's been about three years.

dialogue.content: 3年もお勤めしていると周りの方とも、信頼関係は出来上がっていますね。
dialogue.English: After working there for three years, you must have built a relationship of trust with your colleagues.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お子さんを育てながら、仕事をしていくには、やはり、家族を含め周りの方の協力が必要と思います。
dialogue.English: I believe that in order to work while raising a child, you really need the support of those around you, including your family.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 保育園から連絡が入り、迎えに行かなければならなくなったら、周りの方に、仕事をお願いして、お迎えに行ける環境を作って見ては、いかがかと思いました。
dialogue.English: I was thinking, what if you tried to create a supportive environment at work? For example, when the daycare calls and you have to go pick her up, you could ask colleagues to cover your tasks so you can leave. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: 職場には、子育て経験者がいると思うので理解していただけるのではないかと思うのですが如何ですか。
dialogue.English: I imagine there are people at your workplace who have experience raising children, so they might be understanding. What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね…前回は、たまたま私がいないと駄目な状況だったし、突然だっかので、準備も出来ていなくて…上司や同僚に相談してみるのはいいかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: That's true... The last time, it just happened to be a situation where I absolutely couldn't leave, and it was so sudden that I wasn't prepared... It might be a good idea to talk to my boss and coworkers.

dialogue.content: 先に、相談しておくとスムーズに職場から離脱できると思います。子育てをしているご家庭では、良くあることですので、子育て経験者の方のお話を聴いてみるのもいいかもしれません。
dialogue.English: If you talk to them beforehand, you'll probably be able to leave work more smoothly when you need to. This is a common situation for families raising children, so it might also be helpful to hear from colleagues who have gone through it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 相談者さんは、他にも何か不安に思っていらっしゃる事はおありですか。
dialogue.English: Is there anything else you're feeling concerned about?

dialogue.content: はい。仕事を続けるとなると、主人になんて言おうかと
dialogue.English: Yes. If I decide to continue working, I'm worried about what to say to my husband.

dialogue.content: そうですね。ご家族の理解が一番必要ですね。
dialogue.English: I see. Your family's understanding is the most important thing, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 100%迷惑をかけないなんて、ないと思うんです。いくら仕事場で協力してもらうと言っても
dialogue.English: I don't think it's possible to avoid inconveniencing them 100% of the time, even with a supportive workplace.

dialogue.content: 心配です
dialogue.English: I'm worried.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 熱だけじゃ無いと思いますし
dialogue.English: And it won't just be fevers, I'm sure.

dialogue.content: そうですね。子どもには何が起こるか親でも予測はできないですよね。
dialogue.English: That's true. Even as parents, we can't predict everything that will happen with children, can we?

dialogue.content: 私の様な事情だと、仕事を諦めないといけないんでしょうか
dialogue.English: In a situation like mine, do I have to give up my job?

dialogue.content: やっぱり
dialogue.English: Is that what it comes down to?

dialogue.content: 私は、そうは思いません。相談者さんの意思を尊重したいと思います。
dialogue.English: I don't think so. I want to respect your wishes.

dialogue.content: ご主人とよく話し合う必要はあると思います。
dialogue.English: I do think it's necessary to have a thorough discussion with your husband.

dialogue.content: そうしたいんですけど…今回も、辞めろと言われて、ショックで
dialogue.English: I want to, but... when he told me to quit this time, I was so shocked.

dialogue.content: 我が子が可愛いのかなと思ってしまいました
dialogue.English: It made me wonder if he was thinking that she's his own flesh and blood.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。お子さんが熱を出したのは、相談者さんのせいではないですから。相談者さんのお子さんへの愛情は、実の親と何ら変わらないと思います。そして、家庭も大事に考えておられる。
dialogue.English: I understand. It's not your fault that your daughter got a fever. I believe your love for her is no different from that of a biological parent, and it's clear you care deeply about your family.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 我が子がかわいいのは、当然ですが、相談者さんの愛情も負けてはいないと感じました。
dialogue.English: It's natural for a parent to adore their own child, but I feel that your love is every bit as strong.

dialogue.content: そのつもりです。可愛いと思います。ただ、仕事は私の精神的支えでもあるので、辞めたら多分辛くなると思うんです
dialogue.English: I believe so. She is very dear to me. But my job is also my mental support system, so I think it would be very hard for me if I quit.

dialogue.content: お子さんとの信頼関係が良好であれば、ご主人にそれを見せて安心してもらうのも一つかとも思いました。
dialogue.English: If you have a good, trusting relationship with your daughter, perhaps showing that to your husband could be one way to reassure him.

dialogue.content: 話が前後して申し訳ありません。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry for jumping around a bit.

dialogue.content: 相談者さんのお気持ちも大事にしたいと思います。
dialogue.English: I want to make sure we honor your feelings in this.

dialogue.content: そのお気持ちを素直に、ご主人にお話しすることは可能でしょうか。
dialogue.English: Do you think you could share those feelings honestly with your husband?

dialogue.content: そうですね…仕事を続けたいから、と言ってみます。主人が納得するかどうかは分かりませんが、言うだけ言ってみます
dialogue.English: Yes… I'll try telling him that I want to continue working. I don't know if he'll agree, but I'll at least say it.

dialogue.content: 主人は、義母に迷惑をかけたのも気に入らないのだと思います
dialogue.English: I think my husband is also upset that we inconvenienced his mother.

dialogue.content: 男は、母親から何か言われると弱い部分がありますから。でも、お義母様は、子ども嫌いではありませんよね。夫婦円満、家庭円満の秘訣は、コミュニケーションとよく言われます。
dialogue.English: Men often have a weak spot when it comes to their mothers. But your mother-in-law doesn't dislike children, does she? It's often said that communication is the secret to a happy marriage and a happy home.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 建設的にこうすれば、お互いが上手くいくという案を考えて、お話を進めてみては如何でしょうか。相談者さんならばきっと両立できると思います。
dialogue.English: Perhaps you could think of some constructive ideas that would work for both of you and use those to start the discussion. I believe you can find a way to balance both.

dialogue.content: ちょっと自信はありませんが…やってみます
dialogue.English: I'm not very confident, but… I'll try.

dialogue.content: これは、私、個人の考え方になってしまうかも知れませんが、女性が家でじっとしている時代ではないと思います。働きたい意思がある方には、どんどん社会に出てもらう時代なのではないかと。
dialogue.English: This may be just my personal opinion, but I don't think this is an era where women are expected to simply stay at home. I believe it's a time when those who want to work should be encouraged to participate in society.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 健康面でも、働いている女性は、若々しく健康でいる方が多いそうです。働き過ぎには注意ですが。
dialogue.English: In terms of health, they say that working women tend to be more youthful and healthy. You have to be careful not to overdo it, of course.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そして、数ある男性、女性の中からお互いを選んだ相手を尊敬して、お話をしてくださいね。そうしたらきっと伝わると思います。
dialogue.English: And when you talk to him, please do so with respect for the partner you chose from among all others. If you do that, I'm sure your feelings will get through to him.

dialogue.content: はい。話してみます
dialogue.English: Okay. I'll try talking to him.

dialogue.content: また、何か困ったことがありましたら相談んに来てください。そして、時間をかけてお互いが理解していけると信じています。
dialogue.English: If you run into any more trouble, please come back and talk with me. I believe that with time, you and your husband can reach an understanding.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 少しは、楽になれましたでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Are you feeling a little better now?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 一時間が経過してしまいました。本日のご相談を終了させて頂きます。本日は、相談に来ていただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Our hour is up, so we'll have to end today's session here. Thank you so much for coming in to talk today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: （お疲れ様でした。本日は、ありがとうございました。大変、勉強になりました。まだまだ未熟者でありますが今後も宜しくお願い致します。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your work today. I appreciate it. This was a great learning experience for me. I'm still inexperienced, but I look forward to working with you again in the future.)

dialogue.content: こちらこそです。ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Likewise. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ロールプレイを終了させて頂きます。
dialogue.English: We will now conclude the role-play.
